reason: Design review of CP-3 and CP-4 found that the proofs in both scopes ran as the owner login, which skips every row rule, and that the rule design had gaps (a role code in no group, two id spaces for one person, educators who would see nothing at switch-over, views and definer functions that bypass rules). No existing skill covers Postgres access-rule design or proof.

In the CP-3/CP-4 design drafts the agent asserted that views skip row rules and that the browser suite runs as the owner. Both were false here: every view already sets security_invoker = true, and ci.yml runs the site as app_web. Reviewers caught both; the rule as written invites the same error.
Align this skill's category with the umbrella it is being absorbed into (database), so the umbrella and everything it absorbs share one category.
Absorbed into engine-schema-change as its access-rules section. Its evidence files are left to the promoter; the skill is archived, not destroyed.
